_: SRD 5.2.1 level 4 and 5 spells, CC-BY-4.0. Ranges are in squares: one square is five feet. A spell marked 'approximated' never ships under its SRD name.

effects.note: SRD 5.2.1 (SRD p.112): one creature you can see within 30 feet, Cha save or it is transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration, Incapacitated there. +1 creature per slot level above 4

the demiplane is off the board: the mini stands beside the map. When the spell ends it reappears in the space it left or the nearest unoccupied one. Held for the full minute (10 rounds), an Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey or Fiend doesn't return - it goes to its home plane

SRD 5.2.1: teleport to a spot within 500 feet you can see, visualize or describe, with one willing creature from beside you arriving within 5 feet of you. Arriving in an occupied space deals 4d6 Force to each traveller and the teleport fails
SRD 5.2.1: a creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends - attacking does not end it
SRD 5.2.1: an opaque wall of fire up to 60 feet long, or a ring 20 feet across, on the ground within range; one side, picked at the cast, burns out to 10 feet
when it appears, each creature in the wall makes a Dex save: 5d8 fire, half on a success
entering the wall for the first time on a turn: 5d8 fire, no save
ending a turn in the wall or within 10 feet of its burning side: 5d8 fire, no save. the other side deals nothing

SRD 5.2.1: removes one of: an Exhaustion level, Charmed or Petrified, a curse, a reduction to an ability score, a reduction to the HP maximum. v1 has no exhaustion and nothing that lowers a maximum, so those two are not offered
SRD 5.2.1: any creature you can see, Wis save or Paralyzed; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns

Cube of Force: SRD 5.2.1 Wall of Force (SRD p.172) is an invisible wall - a 10-foot-radius dome or globe, or ten 10-foot panels in any shape. v1 raises it as a cube: a 20-foot square of invisible force on the grid's edges that nothing walks through and everything is seen through (Forcecage's bars). Renamed because the panels aren't possible and a shot passes the bars
